sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fergus Mòr, also called Fergus mac Eirc, holds a place in the history of Scotland. He asked to be crowned in his homeland. He wanted to sit on the Lia Fáil, the Inauguration Stone from the hill of Tara. The stone was brought from Ireland for the event. He chose to keep it instead of returning it. He became an ancestor figure of Scotland.

okr.objective: Fergus Mòr is an ancestor figure of Scotland who kept the Lia Fáil Inauguration Stone.
